lines.english: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎾᏍᎩ ᎢᏥᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᏂᎦᏛ ᎣᏍᏛ ᎩᎬ ᎡᎶᎯ ᎤᏤᏬᏨᎯ, ᎤᏓᏅᏘ ᎡᏈᎵ ᎤᎩᎬ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᏤᎦᎳᏯ ᎤᎩᎬ ᏇᎵᎦᏯ ᎤᏪᏥ ᏅᏛᏍᏗ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᏤᏥᎸ ᎤᏜᏓᏅᏛ ᎤᏛᎾ-ᏗᎦᎳᏫᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᎠᏥᎸᏃ-ᎨᎳᏍᏗᏱ.
lines.text: Na-s-gi i-tsi-lu-tse-di-yi ni-ga-dv o-s-dv gi-gv e-lo-hi u-tse-wo-tsv-hi, u-da-nv-ti E-qui-li u-gi-gv nv-da-gv-wa-da-le-nv-dv, Tse-ga-la-ya u-gi-gv Que-li-ga-ya u-we-tsi nv-dv-s-di, na-s-gi tse-tsi-lv u-dla-nv-dv u-dv-na--di-ga-la-wi-i-s-di-yi a-tsi-lv-no--ge-la-s-di-yi.
lines.english: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
lines.emitted_text: nvhski itsiluhtsehkiyi nikata ohsta akikv elohi utsewotsvhi utanhhs khi ekwili ukikv nyitukvwitalenvta tsekalaya ukika welikaya uwetsi utvhsti nvhski tsetsilv utlanvta uthana tikilawi'ihstiyi atsilanho kelhstiye

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏂᎦᏛ ᏓᏳᎾᎵᏱᎶᎮᎵ ᎯᎠ ᎪᎯ ᏣᏁᎭ.
lines.text: U-do-hi-yu-hi-ya hi-a ni-tsv-we-se-ha; hi-a na-s-gi ni-ga-dv da-yu-na-li-yi-lo-he-li hi-a go-hi tsa-ne-ha.
lines.english: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
lines.emitted_text: utohiyuhiya hi'a nitsvwehseha v hi'a nahski nikatv tvyunalhi'iloheli hi'a khohi tsaneha

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ!  ᏥᎷᏏᎵᎻ!  ᎠᎾᏙᎴᎰᏍᎩ ᏘᎯᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎨᏣᎷᏤᏗᏱ ᎨᏥᏅᏒᎯ ᏅᏯ ᏛᏂᏍᏗᏍᎩ!  ᏯᏃᎩᏳ ᎠᏆᏚᎵᏍᎬ ᎦᏥᏯᏟᏐᏗᏱ ᏗᏤᏥ, ᎾᏍᎩᏯ ᏣᏔᎦ ᏥᏕᎦᏟᏏᏍᎪ ᏧᏪᏥ ᎠᏂᏛ ᏗᎧᏃᎨᏂ ᎭᏫᏂᏗᏢ; ᎠᏎᏃ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏣᏚᎵᏍᎨᎢ.
lines.text: Tsi-lu-si-li-mi!  Tsi-lu-si-li-mi!  a-na-do-le-ho-s-gi ti-hi-hi, a-le ge-tsa-lu-tse-di-yi ge-tsi-nv-sv-hi nv-ya dv-ni-s-di-s-gi!  ya-no-gi-yu a-qua-du-li-s-gv ga-tsi-ya-tli-so-di-yi di-tse-tsi, na-s-gi-ya tsa-ta-ga tsi-de-ga-tli-si-s-go tsu-we-tsi a-ni-dv di-ka-no-ge-ni ha-wi-ni-di-tlv; a-se-no v-tla yi-tsa-du-li-s-ge-i.
lines.english: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎬᏂᏳᏉ ᎢᏣᏤᎵ ᎦᎵᏦᏕ ᏅᏔ ᏁᏨᏁᎸ.
lines.text: Gv-ni-yu-quo i-tsa-tse-li ga-li-tso-de nv-ta ne-tsv-ne-lv.
lines.english: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
lines.emitted_text: kvniyukwu'i itsatseli kalhtsote uthana netsvnela

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎯᎠᏰᏃ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ; ᎥᏝ ᏴᎨᏍᎩᎪᏩᏛ ᎪᎯ ᎢᏳᏓᎴᏅᏛ, ᎬᏂ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏥᏪᏒᎭ; ᎠᏥᎸᏉᏗᏳ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏱᎰᏩ ᏕᎤᏙᎥ ᏥᎦᎷᎯᏍᏗᎭ.
lines.text: Hi-a-ye-no ni-tsv-we-se-ha; v-tla yv-ge-s-gi-go-wa-dv go-hi i-yu-da-le-nv-dv, gv-ni hi-a ni-tsi-we-sv-ha; A-tsi-lv-quo-di-yu na-s-gi Yi-ho-wa de-u-do-v tsi-ga-lu-hi-s-di-ha.
lines.english: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
